next.reason: 1985: HIGH-VALUE and LOW-VALUE written as literals in SPECIAL-NAMES are the highest/lowest characters 'in the native collating sequence'. §2023:12.3.7.4 GR10: the same, 'in the native alphanumeric collating sequence' unless NATIONAL is specified (new syntax). §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR6 and GR7 also define the high-value and low-value formats 'when referenced in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph' (by the compile-time collating sequence); read with GR10, a 1985 program gets the same characters.
